payload.core_mechanism_summary: Impartial game on string: Grundy numbers computed via memoized recursion over substrings; moves split string into left/right independent parts, XOR their SG values.
payload.rationale: State is substring boundaries (start, end) -> 2D DP. Recursion with memoization computes SG values, combining subgames via XOR. Classic interval DP pattern for impartial games.
